about: The Secret asks God to sanctify the gifts dedicated to Him and, appeased, look upon us through these same gifts. It invokes Stanislaus’s intercession as martyr and bishop.

s01.translation: Lord, sanctify the gifts dedicated to You, and, with blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, interceding, look upon us with favor, as You are appeased through these same gifts. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

alignments.gloss: with blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, interceding
appeased, look upon us with favor
who lives and reigns with You

w004.explanation: The gifts have been dedicated to God. The Latin verb here means dedicate, not say or speak.

w007.explanation: Stanislaus is the one interceding. God is the one asked to sanctify the gifts and regard us.

w016.explanation: “Us” is the object of God’s attention. The gifts are the means named in “through these same gifts.”

w017.explanation: God is the one described as appeased. “Us” is the object of His attention.

w035.explanation: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
